subject: Web Development
title: Why It's Called JavaScript
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Why It's Called JavaScript.

hook.text: JavaScript and Java have almost nothing in common. So why the shared name?

buildup.text: Mocha was renamed LiveScript, then JavaScript in a marketing deal with Sun Microsystems.

discovery.text: Sun's Java was the hottest language in 1995. Netscape wanted to ride that hype wave.

twist.text: The name confused beginners for decades. It's the most misleading name in programming.

climax.text: Despite the branding trick, JavaScript carved out its own identity through the browser.

punchline.text: A marketing stunt named the web's language.

quiz.question: Why was it renamed to JavaScript?
